name: Consensus
description:
The Consensus Connector acts as a smart bridge that connects Claude directly to the Consensus Demo Automation Platform. This connection allows users to manage their entire Consensus demo ecosystem through natural, conversational language, allowing for instant access to the demo library. Users can request demo transcripts, create personalized DemoBoards, gain content insights, and perform important sales actions without ever leaving their Claude workspace. By surfacing predictive customer intelligence and engagement data, Consensus helps transform users' Claude instance into a strategic sales co-pilot that helps deliver the right content, to the right buyers, at the right time.
Instantly manage your entire Consensus demo ecosystem and accelerate deals directly within Claude. The Consensus Connector gives you conversational access to your demo library, customer intelligence, and real-time engagement data. This means you get predictive, data-backed recommendations on the 'next best action' to progress a deal, ensuring you deliver the right content at the right time.
You can use the Consensus Connector to:

Instantly search your demo library for the most relevant content by keyword, owner, or date. Example: 'Find promoted demos about security compliance created in the past 30 days.'
Generate personalized DemoBoards with multiple recipients and set custom expiration dates using natural language. Example: 'Create a DemoBoard for John Smith and Smith Corp with our top three product demos, expiring in 30 days.'
Retrieve and analyze demo transcripts. Example: 'Get the transcript for our security compliance demo and summarize the main talking points around GDPR.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Consensus to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Consensus to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.goconsensus.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Consensus MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consensus lists 15 MCP tools, including create_demoboard, get_current_user, get_demo, get_demoboard, get_transcript, marketing_by_demo, sales_by_customer, sales_by_demo, sales_data_for_groups, sales_data_for_user, sales_leaderboard, and search_demoboards.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Consensus?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Consensus in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Consensus requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Consensus is developed by Consensus. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
